The loop should continue with the next iteration, using the returned state.

`ForInStep.yield` is produced by `continue` and by reaching the bottom of the loop body.
name: ForInStep.yield

  The loop should continue with the next iteration, using the returned state.

  -/
  | yield : α → ForInStep α
